t: A safeguard he built into his own anger
a: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
p: Allāhumma fa-ayyumā ʿabdin mu'minin sabbabtuhu fa-jʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma-l-qiyāmah.
m: O Allah, any believing servant I have cursed, make that a means of nearness to You for him on the Day of Rising.
